column1: # The M4 frozen incident corpus. THIS FILE IS THE INCIDENT: it is committed, checksum-pinned by
# the gate, and never regenerated by the code it tests. docs/M4-TAINT.md names its role.
# session|<session-id>                       — a Loom session; its branch carries the same name
# fork|<from-branch>|<new-branch>            — an agent hypothesis fork (opened before any data)
#   sources: comma-separated system:record; the reserved internal form mutiny:<table>/<key>
#   cites another MutinyDB row (the loader hex-encodes the key per the M4 convention)
# downstream|<system:record>|<branch>|<table>|<key> — the corpus's OWN declaration of what is
#   downstream of each poisoned source; the oracle world and the expected plan are built from
#   these lines, never from the taint code under test.
